save_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to save a delayed memory report.
rules: Use this marker only after the user explicitly asks to create/save a delayed memory report.
title, summary, tags, and body are required fields.

tags: concise comma-separated retrieval hooks. Include stable topic/project terms plus distinctive words or short phrases the USER actually used; avoid broad/common tags. Tag matching is case-insensitive and lexical.

facts_ids: exact F<number> ids represented by this report. anchor_fact_ids: 1-3 key ids from facts_ids that must remain visible in <LONG_TERM_MEMORY>; leave both empty when no L4 facts are consolidated.
attachments_ids: exact existing six-character file ids linked to the report; otherwise empty.
Use only ids visible in context; do not invent new ids. anchor_fact_ids must be a valid subset of facts_ids.
